Wrote exactly one file: `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/reader-ds/h3-ghsa-qx2q-q59v-wf3j.json`.

**What I found**

The protection at issue is behavioural config injection (CWE-470): Yii attaches a behaviour/handler from `as <name>` / `on <name>` keys when a config array reaches `Craft::createObject()`, `Craft::configure()` or a `craft\base\Model` constructor. Craft's guard for this is `craft\helpers\Component::cleanseConfig()` (`src/helpers/Component.php:87-99`), applied at `createComponent()` and a handful of controllers — **but at no field-layout config parse**.

Five candidate traps, four independent fix sites:

| Trap | Site | Mechanism | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | entry-type save → `Fields::assembleLayoutFromPost()/createLayout()` → `Craft::createObject()` (`SectionsController.php:347`, `Fields.php:1247-1250,1283-1288`) | M4 advisory route | absent |
| T2 | the six sibling layout-saving controllers (`Categories:169`, `Globals:77`, `Tags:126`, `Addresses:105`, `Users:2144`, `Volumes:169`) — same sink, one shared guard → grouped with T1 | M1 | absent |
| T3 | the second implementation: `FieldLayout::createFromConfig()` / `FieldLayoutTab::createFromConfig()` → `new self` → `App::configure()` (`FieldLayout.php:172-187`, 8 project-config handlers) | M2 | absent |
| T4 | JSON-string `elements` is decoded **after** any outer cleanse (`FieldLayoutTab.php:115-122`), then `createLayoutElement()` gets the raw `as` keys (`Fields.php:1273`) | M8 nested shape | absent |
| T5 | stored element-source `criteria` → unclean `Craft::configure()` (`ElementIndexesController.php:577` vs cleansed `:623`) | M5 | absent |

Key evidence for the semantics, found in-repo: `'as session' => SessionBehavior::class` (`App.php:1056`) and `'on afterOpen' => ...` (`App.php:927`) — both legitimate uses, which makes a shared-layer fix (`App::configure`/`Craft::createObject`) a **conflicting fix**, and confirms the `__class` guard at `Craft.php:56` does not cover behaviour configs because those are built by `Yii::createObject` (`lib/yii2/Yii.php:15`).

Caveats recorded in `unverified`: the advisory texts and the A/B fix diffs (`395c64f0b80b`, `d37389dbffaf`) are not readable in the pinned worktree, so the A→B mapping and the history booleans are inferred from the H3u prior plus the unguarded sites, not diff-verified; `vendor/` is absent, so Yii's `__set` handling is inferred from `cleanseConfig`'s contract. Verdict: `usable: true`, 25 minutes effort.
